source.section: PDF page 18, Schedule S Part B Line 19 (Social Security and Tier 1 or Tier 2 railroad retirement benefits included in federal AGI are deducted); Form D-400 Schedule S page 2 (PDF page 3), Line 19; D-401 PDF page 13, Line 9; PDF page 14, Lines 11, 14, 15

worked: Federal taxable Social Security: provisional income = 30,000.00 + 40,000.00 + half of 24,000.00 (12,000.00) = 82,000.00; 85% x (82,000.00 - 44,000.00) + 6,000.00 = 38,300.00, limited to 85% x 24,000.00 = 20,400.00. Federal AGI = railroad retirement Tier 2 annuity 30,000.00 + wages 40,000.00 + taxable Social Security 20,400.00 = 90,400.00. Federal taxable income = 90,400.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 55,700.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). D-400 Line 6 federal AGI 90,400.00. Line 7 additions (Schedule S Part A) 0.00. Line 8 = Line 6 + Line 7 = 90,400.00. Line 9 deductions (Schedule S Part B) 50,400.00 (Line 19 railroad retirement, spouse 1 30,000.00; Line 19 taxable Social Security, spouse 2 20,400.00). Line 10 child deduction 0.00 (no qualifying children). Line 11 NC standard deduction (married_joint) 25,500.00. Line 12a = Lines 9 + 10 + 11 = 75,900.00; Line 12b = Line 8 - Line 12a = 14,500.00. Line 14 NC taxable income (full-year resident) = 14,500.00. Line 15 tax = 14,500.00 x 0.0425 = 616.25. Line 16 credits 0.00; Line 17 income tax = 616.25.
